settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: Available payment methods are shown at checkout.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: When your order ships, check your shipping confirmation email for tracking information. Contact us if you need help with your order.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Please check our shipping policy for confirmed processing and delivery information.

settings.question: Do you offer international shipping?
settings.answer: Enter your delivery address at checkout to see available shipping options.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Please review our return policy before purchasing, or contact us with questions.

settings.question: Can I exchange an item for another size?
settings.answer: Contact us with your order number and the size you need so we can help.

settings.question: How do I care for my apparel?
settings.answer: Follow the care instructions on the garment label and product page.

settings.question: How do I choose my size?
settings.answer: Check the product description and size guide, or contact us for help before ordering.
